name: College Move-Out Checklist
description: An end-of-year checklist for cleaning, packing and moving out of a dorm.

items.text: Confirm the exact move-out deadline and check-out hours.
items.note: Late departures often trigger daily fees — confirm the cutoff early.

items.text: Review the check-out and cleaning requirements.
Reserve a vehicle, storage or shipping if needed.
Coordinate timing and tasks with your roommate.
Gather boxes, tape, bags and labels in advance.
Schedule any travel home around the deadline.
Separate items into keep, store, donate and trash.
Decide what goes home versus into summer storage.
Sell or give away things you no longer need.
Set aside donations for a campus or local drop-off.
Empty the fridge and toss expired food.
Return any borrowed or rented items.
Start with off-season and rarely used items.
Pack heavy items in small, sturdy boxes.
Wrap fragile items and electronics carefully.
Keep an essentials bag for your final days.
Label each box with contents and destination.
Keep important documents and valuables with you.
Remove all trash, tape and wall hooks.
Dust surfaces and wipe down furniture.
Clean the desk, shelves, drawers and closet.
Sweep, vacuum and mop the floor.
Clean any sink, microwave or fridge in the room.
Leave the room as close to move-in condition as possible.
Move stored items to a storage unit or service.
Ship boxes home if driving isn't practical.
Confirm pickup or drop-off times for any service.
Insure or photograph valuable shipped items.
Keep tracking numbers and receipts.
Load your vehicle the night before if possible.
Do a final walk-through for forgotten items.
Photograph the empty, cleaned room.
Complete the official check-out inspection.
Return your room key or access card on time.
items.note: Lost keys often mean a re-keying charge against your deposit.

items.text: Update your mailing address with the school.
Confirm your deposit return process and timeline.

faq.q: When should I start packing for dorm move-out?
faq.a: Begin a week or two before the deadline by packing off-season clothes and items you don't use daily. Starting early avoids cramming the whole job into finals week.

faq.q: How do I get my dorm deposit back?
faq.a: Clean the room thoroughly, repair or report any damage, remove all belongings, and complete the official check-out process. Compare the room to your move-in condition form to dispute unfair charges.

faq.q: What should I do with stuff I can't take home?
faq.a: Sort items into keep, store, donate and trash. Use a summer storage service or a friend nearby for bulky items, and donate or sell what you no longer need.

faq.q: What happens if I miss the move-out deadline?
faq.a: Late move-out often results in daily fees and can affect your housing standing. Confirm the exact deadline and check-out hours, and ask early if you need an extension.

faq.q: Can I download this checklist as a PDF?
faq.a: Yes. Print the checklist or download the PDF and tick off each move-out task as you complete it.
